div.l: And therof / toke the Sompnour lytyl hede
For curs wol she / ryht as soylyng saveth
And also war him / of significauit
In daunger hadde he / at his owne gyse
The yong gerlys / of the Dyocyse
And knew here conseil / and was al here reed
A garlond hadde he / set vpon his heed
As gret as it were / for an ale stake
A bokeler hadde he / made him of a cake
Wyth him Rood / a Ientyl pardoner pardoner
Of Rouncyvale / his frend and his comper
That streyht was come / from the court of Rome
Wel loved he song / come hedir love to me
This pardoner bar wyth him / a styff bordou
Was neuer trompe / of half so gret a sown
This pardoner hadde heer as yelwe as wex
But smothe it heng / as doth a stryk of flex
Bi vncis huge / his lokkys that he hadde
And therwᵗith he his shuldrys over spradde
But thynne it lay / by culpownys on and oon
But hood for Iolyte / wered he noon
For it was trussed vp / in his walet
Him thoht he rood / al of the newe get
Dischevele save his cappe / he rood all bare
Suche glaryng eyen hadde he / as an hare
A vernycle had he / shewed vpon his cappe
His walet biforn him / in his lappe
Breed ful of pardon / come fro Rome al hoot
A voys hadde as smal as hadde a got
No beede hadde he / ne nevir shuld haue
As moche atat it was / as it were late shave
I trow he were / a geldyng or a mare
But of his chch craft / fro Berwyk on to ware
Ne was the such / an nothir pardoner
For in his male he hadde a pelwe bere /
